passages.heading: <frameset> HTML frameset element
passages.text: Avoid using this feature in new projects. This feature may be a candidate for removal from web standards or browsers. See full compatibility Learn more The <frameset> HTML element is used to contain <frame> elements. Note: Because the use of frames is now discouraged in favor of using <iframe>, this element is not typically used by modern websites.

passages.heading: Attributes
passages.text: Like all other HTML elements, this element supports the global attributes. cols This attribute specifies the number and size of horizontal spaces in a frameset. rows This attribute specifies the number and size of vertical spaces in a frameset.

passages.heading: A frameset document
passages.text: A frameset document has a <frameset> element instead of a <body> element. The <frame> elements are placed within the <frameset>. <!doctype html> <html lang="en-US"> <head> <!-- Document metadata goes here --> </head> <frameset cols="50%, 50%"> <frame src="https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/iframe" /> <frame src="https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/frame" /> </frameset> </html> If you want to embed another HTML page into the <body> of a document, use an <iframe> element.
